reason: A Node.js bridge that connects local DSH agents to WeChat through Tencent’s iLink Bot API, supporting persistent per-contact sessions, local task execution, file exchange, and media handling.

summaries.zh: 通过腾讯 iLink Bot API 将本机 DSH 智能体连接到微信，支持消息往返、持久会话、文件交换和媒体处理。
summaries.en: Connects local DSH agents to WeChat through Tencent’s iLink Bot API with message exchange, persistent sessions, file transfer, and media handling.

capabilities: Connects to Tencent iLink and WeChat for login and message exchange
Receives WeChat messages and invokes local DSH tasks
Reads and writes local conversation history, workspaces, credentials, and media files
Uploads and downloads media through Tencent endpoints
Maintains per-contact sessions, memory, and working directories
